text:
maya: Heads up — planning to enable nova-13b-compact in catalog at 21:00 UTC 2026-03-28. Need fallback ordering, pin policy, and rollback thresholds.
jordan: +1. What traffic % are we starting at? canary or full?
maya: canary 5% first hour, ramp to 30% over 6h if latency/cost look good.
alex: FYI this model is quant-v2; latency profiles look fine but KV cache warmup might spike tail latency for cold prefixes.
priya: Suggest fallback ladder: nova-13b-compact -> nova-13b-quant -> nova-7b-stable. If nova-13b-quant not available, go to nova-7b.
maya: sounds reasonable. also want to pin session affinity for rollout users for 12h to avoid thrash.
jordan: deploy-bot, can you schedule the canary and attach rollout params?
deploy-bot: @channel deploy scheduled: model_enable(nova-13b-compact) at 4441238400. Canary: 5% for 1h -> ramp policy: linear to 30% over 6h. Fallbacks set as: [nova-13b-compact, nova-13b-quant, nova-7b-stable]. Pin TTL: 12h. Rollback triggers: error-rate +3% baseline OR p95 latency +200ms OR token-cost delta > 25%.
priya: Minor tweak — reorder fallback to try nova-13b-quant-v1 before nova-13b-quant (v2) because v1 has been validated on regen tests.
alex: Agree with priya. Also set eviction TTL for cache entries shorter for first 2h to avoid stale KV bloat.
maya: Can we add a safety gate: if overall cost per 1M tokens increases > 18% within 2h, auto-pause ramp and notify eng-sre?
sre-oncall: will monitor. suggest auto-fallback-enable: on pause -> shift 100% to nova-13b-quant-v1 and open incident channel.
jordan: add note to release notes: short blurb + quant differences + known tokenization change for some prompts.
priya: I'll draft release note. small sample snippet to include:

```json
{ "model": "nova-13b-compact", "canary": "5% 1h", "fallbacks": ["nova-13b-compact","nova-13b-quant-v1","nova-7b-stable"], "pin_ttl": "12h" }
```

maya: ok, final checklist: 1) deploy-bot scheduled (done), 2) priya release note, 3) alex infra pre-warm KV cache job 30m before, 4) slo watchers in place, 5) oncall ready. anyone object?
alex: no objections.
priya: on it — will post release note and attach canary evaluation query.
sre-oncall: will standby and add throttles to routing policy if needed.
jordan: tagging product for communications: @product-team please note minor model behavioral diffs.
maya: thanks everyone — let's sync 20m before change window in #eng-sre for final go/no-go.
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled for 4441238400 — use `/deploy cancel 4441234567` to cancel.
